name: Hearthwardens
description: Civic stewards who maintain Hearthwell viability, approve public works, and lead crisis response.

name: Ledger Houses
description: Archivists who track ancestry, property, contracts, memory disputes, and historical legitimacy.
function: Lineage records, contracts, and memory governance

name: The Green Apron Guild
description: Farmers, cooks, brewers, fishers, and herbalists. They control food stability and festival provisions.

name: Votive Smiths
description: Crafters who bind tools to vows, professions, family lines, and town history.

name: Wayfarer Compact
description: Adventurer network that maps rifts, escorts caravans, and reports anomalous topogenic changes.

name: The Null Choir
description: Philosophical cult that believes all distinctions cause suffering and should dissolve back into the White Quiet.

name: Kinless Court
description: A political faction for immigrants, orphans, exiles, unmarried NPCs, and players without local family ties.
function: Advocacy for the unaffiliated and immigrant rights
